Korean: 주인님의 요청이라면 아스모는 언제든지 준비 완료라구요!
English: If it is your request Master then Asmo is always ready!
Leave it to me! Asmo will make them fall head over heels!
Alright! Call me whenever you need me!
Leave it to me! I will stir fry them nice and hot!
Yaaawn... Maybe today will be the day we hit the jackpot...

Korean: 행운의 여신이 너랑 함께할 거야... 아마도... 음냐...
English: Lady Luck will be with you... probably... mnya...

Korean: 셰리 님의 부름이라면 레비아탄은 언제든 응답하겠습니다...
English: If Lady Sherry calls then Leviathan will answer anytime...

Korean: 레비아탄은 셰리 님과 함께할 수 있어서 행복합니다... 아주 많이요.
English: Leviathan is happy to be with Lady Sherry... very happy.
Um... Are you really sure I am okay...?
I-I will do my best!

Korean: 카캇! 내 몸값은 꽤 비싸다구요, 고객님?
English: Kakak! My price is pretty high, dear customer.
Since it is a V.I.P. request, this one is a special service!
If Sherry calls, I come running!
By Sherry's side, that is my place!

Korean: 푹신푹신 타임: 전투 종료마다 (10%/15%/25%) 확률로 체력 브레이크 최대치 브레이크 저항 행동력 중 하나의 스탯이 영구적으로 (1/2/3)만큼 상승합니다. 체력은 (91/182/273)만큼 상승합니다
English: Fuwa Fuwa Time: At the end of each battle there is a (10%/15%/25%) chance to permanently increase one stat from HP Max Break Break Resistance or AP by (1/2/3). HP increases by (91/182/273).

Korean: 천사를 만났어: 적의 힘을 (10%/15%/20%)만큼 3턴간 감소시키고 셰리의 스타일 랭크를 한 단계 상승시킵니다
English: Tenshi ni Fureta yo!: Decreases enemy Strength by (10%/15%/20%) for 3 turns and raises Sherry's Style Rank by 1 level.

Korean: 퓨어퓨어하트: 셰리의 체력을 20% 회복시키고 모든 디버프를 해제합니다. 힘 방어 속도 운이 3턴간 20% 상승합니다
English: Pure Pure Heart: Restores 20% of Sherry's HP and removes all debuffs. Strength Defense Speed and Luck increase by 20% for 3 turns.

Korean: Shiny Days: 전투 종료마다 최대 체력의 (5%/10%/20%)만큼 회복합니다
English: Shiny Days: At the end of each battle recover (5%/10%/20%) of Max HP.

Korean: 에이프런 보이: 적에게 3턴간 화상 디버프를 부여하고 방어를 (7%/10%/15%)만큼 감소시킵니다. 화상 상태인 적은 턴마다 최대 체력의 (2%/3%/5%)만큼 피해를 입습니다
English: Apron Boy: Inflicts Burn on the enemy for 3 turns and decreases Defense by (7%/10%/15%). A burned enemy takes damage equal to (2%/3%/5%) of Max HP each turn.

Korean: 콜라주: 6타 다단 히트 피해를 입힙니다. 각 타격마다 (20%/30%/40%) 확률로 출혈 디버프를 부여합니다. 스킬 피해는 적이 보유 중인 디버프 개수에 비례하여 증가합니다. 출혈 상태인 적은 턴마다 셰리 힘의 (80%/100%/120%)만큼 피해를 입습니다
English: Collage: Deals 6 hit multi hit damage. Each hit has a (20%/30%/40%) chance to inflict Bleed. Skill damage increases based on the number of debuffs on the enemy. A bleeding enemy takes damage equal to (80%/100%/120%) of Sherry's Strength each turn.

Korean: There is a Reason: 전투 종료마다 아이템 리롤을 실행할 때 (10%/20%/35%) 확률로 아이템의 등급이 한 단계 상승합니다
English: There Is a Reason: When rerolling items at the end of battle there is a (10%/20%/35%) chance to increase an item's grade by 1 level.

Korean: This Game: 적에게 힘 방어 속도 운 중 두 개의 스탯을 무작위로 (5%~30%/10%~50%/20%~80%)만큼 3턴간 감소시킵니다
English: This Game: Randomly decreases 2 stats from enemy Strength Defense Speed or Luck by (5%~30%/10%~50%/20%~80%) for 3 turns.

Korean: Deal with the Devil: 적에게 무작위로 6가지 효과 중 하나를 적용합니다. 셰리의 운이 높을수록 좋은 효과가 발생할 확률이 높아집니다
English: Deal with the Devil: Randomly applies 1 of 6 effects to the enemy. The higher Sherry's Luck is the higher the chance of a favorable effect.

Korean: 별자리가 될 수 있다면: 전투 종료마다 (10%/20%/35%) 확률로 일반 등급 아이템을 획득합니다
English: If I Could Be a Constellation: At the end of each battle there is a (10%/20%/35%) chance to obtain a Common grade item.

Korean: 기타와 고독과 푸른 행성: 적의 AP를 3턴간 (15%/25%/40%) 감소시키고 셰리의 AP를 3턴간 (10%/20%/30%) 상승시킵니다
English: Guitar Loneliness and Blue Planet: Decreases enemy AP by (15%/25%/40%) for 3 turns and increases Sherry's AP by (10%/20%/30%) for 3 turns.

Korean: Sweet Hurt: 적에게 5타 다단 히트 피해를 입힙니다. 각 타격마다 적의 버프 1개의 잔여 턴을 1턴씩 줄입니다. 줄인 버프 턴 1개당 피해량이 (15%/20%/30%) 증가합니다
English: Sweet Hurt: Deals 5 hit multi hit damage to the enemy. Each hit reduces the remaining duration of 1 enemy buff by 1 turn. Damage increases by (15%/20%/30%) for each buff turn reduced.

Korean: 나만 유령이야: 전투 종료마다 (10%/15%/25%) 확률로 힘 방어 속도 운 중 하나가 (1/2/3)만큼 상승합니다
English: I'm the Only Ghost: At the end of each battle there is a (10%/15%/25%) chance to increase one stat from Strength Defense Speed or Luck by (1/2/3).

Korean: Neat3: 3턴간 운이 (15%/20%/30%)만큼 증가합니다. 전투 시작 즉시 행동 수치를 (100/150/200)만큼 채워줍니다
English: Neat3: Increases Luck by (15%/20%/30%) for 3 turns. Immediately fills the action gauge by (100/150/200) at the start of battle.

Korean: 해피 스파이럴: 적의 방어를 (20%/30%/40%)만큼 무시하는 강력한 피해를 입힙니다. 스킬 사용 후 (40%/35%/20%) 확률로 숙취가 발생하여 루시퍼의 행동 수치가 50만큼 감소합니다
English: Happy Spiral: Deals powerful damage that ignores (20%/30%/40%) of enemy Defense. After using this skill there is a (40%/35%/20%) chance of Hangover reducing Lucifer's action gauge by 50.

Korean: Viva Namida: 전투 종료 후 획득하는 골드가 (10%/20%/35%)만큼 증가합니다
English: Viva Namida: Gold gained after battle increases by (10%/20%/35%).

Korean: Freek'n You: 3턴간 적의 명중률을 (15%/20%/30%)만큼 감소시키고 방어를 (10%/15%/25%)만큼 감소시킵니다
English: Freek'n You: Decreases enemy Hit Rate by (15%/20%/30%) and Defense by (10%/15%/25%) for 3 turns.

Korean: Layer Cake: 9개의 효과 중 무작위로 3개를 사용합니다. 스킬 레벨에 따라 효과가 강해집니다
English: Layer Cake: Uses 3 random effects from a pool of 9. Effects become stronger based on skill level.

Korean: 워 아이 니: 전투 종료마다 획득하는 경험치가 (10%/20%/35%)만큼 증가합니다
English: Wo Ai Ni: EXP gained after battle increases by (10%/20%/35%).

Korean: 록온: 3턴 동안 셰리의 힘과 방어가 (15%/25%/35%)만큼 증가합니다
English: Lock On: Increases Sherry's Strength and Defense by (15%/25%/35%) for 3 turns.

Korean: 말괄량이로 만들지 마: 적에게 5타 다단 히트 피해를 입힙니다. 각 타격이 적중할 때마다 (15%/20%/30%) 확률로 적이 보유 중인 디버프 1개의 지속 시간을 1턴 연장합니다
English: Don't Make Me a Wild Girl: Deals 5 hit multi hit damage to the enemy. Each successful hit has a (15%/20%/30%) chance to extend the duration of 1 enemy debuff by 1 turn.
